scope: Afghan Pashto-English communication; hypotheses require validation

findings.risk: Thumbs-up and ring-hand gesture meanings vary with context and audience.
findings.validation: Unprompted image-only comprehension across age and regional groups.

findings.risk: Single pictogram may encode the wrong sense.
Unreviewed illustrations can mislead in high-stakes communication.
findings.validation: Fluent bilingual scenario review; do not treat images as translations.
Two-direction dialogue evaluation by independent fluent reviewers.

findings.risk: Intelligibility remains unverified by speakers per engineering handoff.
findings.validation: Blind audio comprehension and regional pronunciation review.
Observe nonreading adults completing tasks without text prompts.

findings.risk: Pictograms may imply narrow cultural or social assumptions.
findings.validation: Comprehension review across different Afghan backgrounds.

findings.risk: Sensitive speech and microphone capture require transparent consent.
findings.validation: Physical-device privacy and consent scenario checks.

findings.risk: Child-oriented illustrations may undermine adult communication.
findings.validation: Adult learner preference and comprehension testing.

findings.risk: Script, transcription or direction may be misread.
findings.validation: Linguist review of both scripts and actual spoken output.
